$Comment: A training contract: the step counts raw experience earned in one skill, so the Amount is an experience total rather than a number of blocks. The level bound in Requires names the same skill as the step, and the board checks it when a player takes the contract. Min 1 is every player's starting level, so it locks nobody out; raise it to save the contract for players further along. The board entry's empty AcceptRequires {} opens the contract to everyone in place of the Normal band's combat level, so a new player can train Mining from the start. Leave AcceptRequires out to put the band's gate back.
